fund_model.fund_name: BlackRock LifePath Index 2060 Fund, Class K

limitations: Illustrative asset-class returns are not fund forecasts; annual fund expense is deducted separately.
No volatility, retirement spending, withdrawals, or withdrawal taxation.
Traditional contribution cash cost uses a simplified fixed marginal tax adjustment.
Annualized employee cap excludes catch-up contributions and does not measure remaining legal current-year room.
Future cap growth is a planning assumption, not future law.
Debt APR and minimums remain fixed; real card conventions can differ.
No new borrowing, variable-rate debts, vesting schedules, or employer true-ups.
Reserve targets and 15% combined saving target are heuristics, not retirement adequacy estimates.

explanation.narrative: This is your initial plan. The priorities are starter reserve, high-interest debt, then full reserve: this balanced order preserves the starter reserve priority despite it already being funded, places debt ahead of additional cash even though no qualifying debt is present, and leaves further reserve building behind debt repayment. Maintaining your contribution helps capture the full employer match, while maintaining debt minimums supports your current debt approach. The investment allocation is an illustrative target-date curve and was not changed.
explanation.state_summary: Your situation supports maintaining your contribution and debt minimum while keeping the balanced cash-priority order. Your starter and full reserves are funded, and you have no high-interest debt.
